corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Craig directly confronts the impersonal alternative, distinguishes a nonphysical primordial condition from familiar quantum processes, and focuses attention on the explanatorily significant finite timing of cosmic origination. Principal limitation: His comparative case moves from the absence of a presently plausible impersonal mechanism to personal agency without independently establishing that nonphysicality or temporally finite initiation discriminates between those categories. Live burden: He must show why a sui generis nonphysical impersonal cause could not be indeterministic, while explaining why intentional agency predicts a universe beginning at a finite time. Locked score: The 76 appropriately recognizes a relevant, explicit full answer whose plausibility framing and strong burden contact nevertheless outrun its limited rival analysis and underdeveloped positive warrant.
